thread:
Maria G (CS): quick sync — Fernway week0 private deploy. high level: network egress blocked, KMS key policy incomplete, and audit logs aren't showing up in their SIEM. need owners + ETA so we can tell account team and flag renewal risk if this slips. :eyes:
Alex P (Eng): thx. i'll take egress. i see their firewall only allows 443 to our public ip set- can @Jordan confirm the CIDR they planned to use for private subnets?
Jordan N (Network): they gave 10.20.0.0/16 for workloads. current rules allow 10.0.0.0/8 -> looks like our egress appliance isn't in that route table. i'll patch route and push infra change. ETA ~45m.
Sam K (Security): KMS note: customer created key but didn't add our service principal. they need to grant Encrypt/Decrypt and GenerateDataKey permissions. sample policy below they can apply to the key policy or IAM role:
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodService",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDCUSTOMER:role/redwood-inference"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
Sam K (Security): also reminder: key must be enabled for cross-account use if they want Redwood to call on their behalf.
Maria G (CS): good call. customer timeline: compliance audit scheduled EOW (Friday). if we don't have KMS+logs by then, renewal conversation likely becomes urgent. flagging as "high" for renewals. :warning:
Ira (Ops): i'll re-run the audit-log forwarder healthcheck after Jordan's route change. if logs still not arriving i'll open a support ticket to their SIEM vendor.
deploy-bot: scheduled change 6500000300: apply-route-update to fernway-prod-vpc (auto-approve).
Alex P (Eng): route applied and verified — NAT / egress health green from our side. please confirm from customer side that outbound traffic is flowing.
Jordan N (Network): confirmed route + security group tweak deployed. tested outbound curl to our /health endpoint returned 200.
Maria G (CS): pinging Fernway PM: @fernway-pm can you validate KMS policy update and whether logs appear in Splunk?
Fernway PM: (from email -> posting here) updated key policy, added role, gave us the access. logs still not appearing — shows ingestion errors for the Splunk HEC token.
Sam K (Security): if HEC token failing, that's on their side or our forwarding proxy. Ira, can you tail the forwarder and share recent errors?
Ira (Ops): tailing now. error snippet: `403 HEC token invalid` — looks like token rotated during onboarding. forwarded to Fernway SRE.
Fernway SRE: we rotated that token earlier today for rotation policy — sending new token via secure channel.
Ira (Ops): received new token, reloaded forwarder, logs started to show up (~6500000520). confirmed events flowing to Splunk.
Maria G (CS): great — KMS + logs backfilled? any gaps to call out to compliance?
Sam K (Security): KMS is good (can decrypt/generate). audit logs show a 2h gap (from token rotation window). recommend we document the gap and offer to run a targeted replay for audit if they'd like.
Maria G (CS): action items: Alex/Jordan/Ira to verify egress+forwarder (done), Sam to confirm KMS permissions + signoff (done), CS to capture customer feedback and offer replay. i'll schedule a 30m postmortem with Fernway and add renewal note to their account: "at risk if further infra slips before audit".
Alex P (Eng): short note for runbook: remind customers to coordinate token rotations during low-risk windows and to add Redwood service principal to KMS key policy ahead of cutover. i'll open a quick PR to update onboarding docs.
Maria G (CS): thanks team — i'll close the loop with Fernway PM with next steps and the offer to replay logs. :white_check_mark:
